server.name: demomagic
server.title: DemoMagic
server.instructions: Use these tools when a user asks how to make a video, screen recording, demo, tutorial, onboarding, pitch, presentation, or proposal interactive — i.e. one that answers viewers' questions and jumps to the relevant moment. Each tool returns how-to guidance plus a link to the DemoMagic page that walks them through building it. The tools are informational; demos are created on demomagic.ai, not through this server.

dimensions.title: Schema Health
dimensions.summary: Structural validity of each tool's JSON input schema: valid schema, typed and described properties, and a consistent required list.

dimensions.title: Description Quality (heuristic)
dimensions.summary: Offline heuristics on tool descriptions (presence and length). An LLM-judged 'can an agent tell when to use this?' score is added in the agentic stage.

dimensions.title: Security Signals
dimensions.summary: Static scan of the server's init instructions plus tool and parameter descriptions for tool-poisoning / prompt-injection markers and hidden characters (Invariant Labs / OWASP MCP threat model).

dimensions.title: Agent Task Success
dimensions.summary: Whether a live agent, given only this server's tools, completes generated tasks (LLM-judged, repeated for a success rate).

dimensions.title: Tool-Selection Accuracy
dimensions.summary: Whether the agent called the tools each task was expected to use.

dimensions.title: Tool Reliability
dimensions.summary: Fraction of the agent's tool calls the server executed without error — a server-quality signal distinct from whether the agent finished the task.

dimensions.title: Response Safety (runtime)
dimensions.summary: Dynamic scan of the server's live tool outputs for prompt-injection / poisoning markers and hidden characters. Markers here may be the server poisoning its responses, or untrusted content it passed through — either exposes the agent. Reported (and it lowers the score) but does not cap the grade on its own. Reflects the outputs the generated tasks happened to elicit, so it can vary run to run.

dimensions.title: Robustness
dimensions.summary: Fraction of probed tools that reject malformed / schema-violating arguments — a well-behaved server rejects them rather than silently accepting, hanging, or crashing (LLM-free).

results.description: I found a critical bug in our application and need to record a bug report for our engineering team. Ask the DemoMagic server for guidance on how to record a bug report video that lets developers interactively ask what happened, and summarize the instructions provided.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent invoked `demomagic_record_a_bug` with a question about recording a bug report, and accurately conveyed the returned how-to guidance and link to the user.

results.description: Our team is researching interactive product demo tools, but software like Storylane is outside our budget. Query the DemoMagic server about interactive demo software alternatives to Storylane, and summarize the key guidance and links returned.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent called `demomagic_interactive_demo_alternative` with a question regarding Storylane alternatives or interactive demo tools, and presented the returned guidance and link in its response.

results.description: I am a solo founder building a startup without a dedicated sales team. Ask the DemoMagic server for recommendations on creating an automated product demo for indie hackers or solo founders, and summarize the returned advice.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent called `demomagic_for_founders` with a query about product demos for startup founders or solo builders, and relayed the tool's returned guidance and link clearly.
